test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

His words wield tremendous influence **__between his followers.__**
solution:
The correct answer is **'among his followers'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition** "between" **is used when referring to two entities.
 
• When referring to more than two entities,** "among"** is used.
 
• So, the** correct phrase** is "among his followers."

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *His words wield tremendous influence **among** his followers.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Within**: "Within" refers to something that is contained or exists inside a particular boundary or limits.
 
• **In: **"In" indicates being inside or within the boundaries of something.
